subject: POC/Trial: success metrics, ownership & kickoff next steps
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@greenglobe.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — trial planning

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Lena and I found the latency/cost examples helpful. We want to move to a short trial to validate three things: (1) response latency under our interactive load, (2) downstream quality (RAG snippets + hallucination checks), and (3) end-to-end deployment fit in our VPC.

Before we lock dates, can you send a concise plan with success criteria, who on both sides owns infra/app/security/procurement tasks, and a realistic timeline for a 3-week trial? Also please include any prerequisites from our side (network, test data, account/team access).

Samir
IT Lead, GreenGlobe

---

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@greenglobe.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@greenglobe.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — trial planning

Samir / Lena — thanks for the clear ask. Below is a compact trial plan we can kick off next week if the dates work. I also copied our engagement owners so responsibilities are explicit.

Quick summary (3-week trial):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, 3–5 days): network connectivity checks, account provisioning, test prompt set & dataset handoff.
- Week 1 (baseline): smoke tests, latency profiling with your interactive load, initial model/config tuning.
- Week 2 (quality): RAG integration tests, hallucination/checkpoint evals, metric collection.
- Week 3 (acceptance): final perf run, customer validation, lessons & wrap — decision gate.

Success criteria (pass/fail style) — propose these for sign-off:
- Latency: p95 endpoint latency < 350ms for 512-token bursts under target concurrency (you mentioned 12 concurrent users).
- Quality: automated evals show ROUGE/F1 within 10% of baseline for the supplied prompt set and no high-severity hallucinations in spot-check (<= 1 per 500 responses).
- Reliability: no more than one transient error per 10k requests; KV cache working for session continuity.
- Infra fit: VPC peering and egress policy validated; model artifacts can be deployed to your dedicated subnet without changes.

Ownership (proposed RACI-lite) — internal participants are listed as Redwood owners. Please confirm or reassign on your side: 
- Infrastructure / Networking: Responsible (GreenGlobe) — tasks: open ports (egress 443 to our endpoint), provide VPC CIDR + test endpoints. Accountable (Redwood): vivek_kulkarni (will coordinate peering and onboarding).
- App integration / RAG connector: Responsible (GreenGlobe) — Lena will hand off sample retrieval code and index. Accountable (Redwood): aisha_rahman (will provide connector template and assist in integration).
- Security & Compliance checks: Responsible (GreenGlobe) — Samir to provide SOC2 control list if you want an audit baseline. Accountable (Redwood): vivek_kulkarni (will supply evidence and encryption/KMS approach).
- Procurement / trial legal: Responsible (GreenGlobe) — procurement contact to approve MSA/PO schedule. Accountable (Redwood): ben_carter (supporting with short term trial license).

Pre-reqs from GreenGlobe:
- Test prompt bundle (CSV) and a representative 1k doc sample set for RAG testing.
- Network contact for peering setup and allowed IPs.
- Point person for procurement questions and internal SLAs.

Attachments: I attached a one-page success-metrics workbook (trial-success-metrics.xlsx) and a short network diagram template (gg-network-diagram.pdf) — fill as you can.

Proposed kickoff options: March 1 (Mon) or March 3 (Wed) morning PT. If you confirm, I'll get Vibe for kickoff and loop in our infra runbook.

Next step (two asks):
1) Samir/Lena: confirm who will own the green items (infra/app/security/procurement) and which kickoff date you prefer.
2) Ben/Vivek (internal): see below for internal notes on procurement timelines and onboarding tasks.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@greenglobe.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@greenglobe.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — trial planning

Looping on procurement and trial license details. Quick internal checklist for a 3-week eval so we can set expectations with procurement at GreenGlobe: 
- Trial license: single account, 3-week duration, standard eval terms (no long-term commitment). Will need PO or signed ack from their procurement lead by day 0 or we shift to demo-only. (Ben — owner to follow up on PO template).
- Billing holdback: we can put usage below $2k on our side as credit for the trial; anything beyond triggers standard invoicing.
- Security questionnaire: if Samir can send the SOC/controls list, we can provide the redacted evidence pack within 3 business days. Vivek will lead on HSM/KMS notes.
- Access: request for a named test user list (3–5 logins) for the trial to help reproduce concurrency.

Tentative procurement timeline: if PO is received by kickoff +1 day, procurement completes within 5 business days (legal clean-up only). If PO is delayed, we can still run an unlicensed connectivity/technical validation but will mark it as "non-billable demo".

I'll attach the short PO template in the Drive link Aisha already shared. Vivek, please confirm the minimum network egress IPs we need so Samir can add them to the firewall rule.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

---

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@greenglobe.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@greenglobe.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call follow-up — trial planning

Thanks Aisha and Ben — this is exactly the level of clarity we need. A few confirmations from our side: 
- Ownership: Samir (me) will own Security & Compliance checks and provide the SOC2 control list by EOD Friday. Lena will own the app/RAG connector handoff (she'll send the sample index and retrieval code monday). Procurement will try to turn the PO by kickoff +2 but I will push for day 0.
- Kickoff: March 3 (Wed) 9:00am PT works best for our infra and product teams. Please send the calendar invite and pre-read.
- Pre-reqs: I'll upload the prompt bundle and a 1k doc sample to the Drive link provided by tomorrow. Also attaching our internal network admin contact in a follow-up.

Agree with the success criteria and the pass/fail gates. If during Week 2 we hit an unrecoverable integration blocker, we reserve the right to re-scope — but the goal is to get the baseline validated.

Samir
IT Lead, GreenGlobe
